data.title: Building the whole product
data.summary: Connecting useful interfaces to dependable services.
data.context: Sample entry: a small cross-functional team turning a complicated workflow into a focused web product. This is demonstration content, not employment history.
data.decisions: Begin with the smallest complete user journey. Keep data contracts explicit, use accessible components, and ship changes that can be observed and rolled back.
data.impact: Sample lessons: clear boundaries reduce coordination cost. A feature is only finished when people can use it and the team can support it.

data.title: Making systems dependable
data.context: Sample entry: improving APIs and asynchronous workflows where reliability mattered more than adding features quickly.
data.decisions: Treat retries, timeouts, and partial failure as normal conditions. Add structured logs and define recovery steps before increasing traffic.
data.impact: Sample lessons: the simplest system the team can operate is often the right starting point. No numerical or commercial results are claimed.

data.title: Learning by building
data.summary: Curiosity, small experiments, and better questions.
data.context: Sample entry: exploring web foundations through small, complete projects and deliberate practice.
data.decisions: Finish a narrow slice, explain its tradeoffs, and revisit the parts that were harder to understand than they needed to be.
data.impact: Sample lessons: writing down decisions makes the next iteration better. Replace this entry with the owner’s actual experience.
